tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Does It Work In guides and provider comparisons by query, country slug (e.g. "china", "japan", "hong-kong"), or topic ("esim", "vpn", "payments", "maps", "ai", "transit").

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Get full compatibility details for a path (e.g. "/china/esim", "/china/alipay", "/compare/airalo-vs-holafly-vs-saily"): official claim vs. verified reality, pre-departure steps, failure modes, recommended providers and FAQs.

tools.name: get_country
tools.description: Get the full compatibility status matrix, guides and recommended providers for a destination slug (e.g. "china", "hong-kong", "japan", "south-korea", "thailand", "vietnam", "indonesia", "turkey", "uae", "taiwan", "europe").

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List tested eSIM, VPN, multi-currency payment and travel booking providers with starting prices and summary notes.

tools.name: report_outdated_info
tools.description: Submit a field report if a carrier rule, app status, payment limit or provider price has changed.
